notes.title: Merry Christmas From Tank Hero VR game studio
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas to every players and we are indie game studio and Tank Hero VR is our big hit VR games and hope you can enjoy it with your family during the Christmas!!!

During the game, you will return to the desert battle, you will be driving tanks through the battle of the fierce street fighting and desert cities to destroy the enemy's foundation and the fortress, and the other side of the armed helicopter, and rescue the hostages. As the first Tank VR games, you will feel the fun of driving tanks.

Enjoy the games and enjoy your life!!!
